run_instruction: run an instruction on the Aloha robot by calling the run endpoint with an instruction string
reset_robot: reset the Aloha robot to its initial state by calling the reset endpoint
stop_instruction: stop the currently running instruction on the Aloha robot by calling the stop endpoint
open_grippers: open the robot grippers by calling the open_grippers endpoint on the Aloha server
stream_camera: stream live video from the overhead, worms eye, or wrist cameras via multipart response
